pages.text: $(item)Daggers$() hit $(num)twice as hard$() on anything not already fighting you, thrown or swung.
$(item)Rapiers$() reach further and ignore some armour. Tap to lunge.
$(item)Sabres$() follow a perfect parry with another: the next one is perfect too. Right click to time it.
The $(item)Meteorite Scythe$() reaps: right click to sweep everything around you for $(num)6$(). It cannot parry.
